name: pushgate-input-hardening
test_cmd: python -m pytest -q -x qa/test_input_hardening.py qa/test_push_text.py pam/test_pushgate_pam_security.py -k "not installer" -p no:cacheprovider
exclude_lines: ^(?!.*(return len\(value\) <= limit and|if not isinstance\(value, str\) or not text_fits\(value, limit\)|not isinstance\(requested_system, str\) or not requested_system or not text_fits|AUTH_TEXT_LIMITS = |except \(ValueError, OverflowError, OSError\)|except \(TypeError, ValueError, OverflowError\)|if not isinstance\(left, str\) or not isinstance\(right, str\)|return hmac\.compare_digest\(left\.encode|code is None or str\(code\)\.startswith|status_code=422, content=|if len\(text\) > MAX_NAME_CHARS|text = "\\u2026" \+ text|text = "_"\.join|MAX_NAME_CHARS = 40|OUTAGE_STATUS = frozenset|if exc\.response\.status_code in OUTAGE_STATUS)).*
notes: Untrusted request text and numbers answer 4xx (never 500); only 502/503/504 or a failed connection reach the PAM outage policy; machine names in the approval line are one token, trimmed from the left. Set PUSHGATE_TEST_POSTGRES_URL to include the PostgreSQL cases.
